engines.label: Capability Engines
engines.text: 15 shared capability engines (ERP core, CRM, procurement, WMS, manufacturing, QMS, DMS, LIMS, EAM, farm management, traceability, commerce, AI, HR, R&D) power every industry solution — built once, reused everywhere.

packs.text: 27 registered industry packs pair a real vertical — pharma, feed, livestock, aquaculture, cosmetics, medical devices, pharmacy, 3PL, and more — with the engines, roles, and data model it needs.

demos.label: Reference Implementations
demos.text: Most industry packs already have a complete, verified reference implementation — real seeded data and end-to-end business flows explored directly in the system. Select industries also get a dedicated public website, like the ones above.

aiAutomation.heading: AI & Automation
aiAutomation.lead: AI is one of our 15 shared capability engines. It's real, working architecture — not a slide — built directly into the modules below.

honesty.heading: How AI works in this environment
honesty.text: Every capability below runs on real architecture: a provider-agnostic routing layer, fallback between models, tenant-level AI policy enforcement, a governed tool registry, permission-scoped data access, and a full audit log of every request — plus a mandatory human-approval step wherever a draft could become a real record. That routing layer is designed to call a real language-model provider of your choice in a production deployment — OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Groq, or a private, self-hosted model. In this public demo specifically, the model response itself is simulated, so you can see exactly how permissions, approvals, and audit logging behave without live model calls or API keys in a public environment.

executiveAssistant.title: Executive Assistant
executiveAssistant.text: Ask plain questions about real operational data — overdue CAPAs, batches on hold, near-expiry inventory, farm FCR performance, revenue trends — and get an answer built from a fixed set of vetted, read-only data tools, with source citations. Results are automatically scoped to what the asking user is actually permitted to see.

qmsCopilot.title: QMS Copilot
qmsCopilot.text: Assists with deviation investigation and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) drafting. Every AI-drafted suggestion is held as a draft and requires a human reviewer's explicit approval — including a rule against self-approval — before it becomes part of the real quality record.

dmsCopilot.title: DMS Copilot
dmsCopilot.text: Compares document revisions and searches controlled documents for relevant content, helping document-control teams find what changed and where an answer already exists.

manufacturingInsight.title: Manufacturing Insight
manufacturingInsight.text: Analyzes real production and batch data to flag delivery delays and yield anomalies worth a closer look.

procurementAssistant.title: Procurement Assistant
procurementAssistant.text: Compares supplier quotations and summarizes supplier history to support a purchasing decision. It never auto-approves a supplier or a purchase — that decision always stays with a human.

farmAssistant.title: Livestock & Aquaculture Assistant
farmAssistant.text: Analyzes feed conversion ratio (FCR), mortality, and pond/farm anomalies across livestock and shrimp/fish farm operations, built on the same real harvest and farm-management data used elsewhere on this platform.

enterpriseSearch.title: Permission-Aware Enterprise Search
enterpriseSearch.text: A real document indexing and retrieval (RAG) pipeline — documents are chunked, indexed, and retrieved to answer questions — with every result scoped to what the requesting user is actually permitted to see, the same permission model enforced everywhere else on this platform.

aiAutomation.governanceNote: All of this runs through the same shared backbone: a governed tool registry, tenant-level AI policy, fallback routing between models, full audit logging of every request, and a growing set of evaluation datasets used to test AI response quality over time.

about.title: About PharmaCountry Enterprise Solutions
about.heroImageAlt: PharmaCountry Enterprise Solutions — our technology and team
about.p1: PharmaCountry is the platform connecting pharmaceutical needs worldwide — a B2B marketplace serving the global pharmaceutical industry across 100+ countries. PharmaCountry Enterprise Solutions is our technology and ERP division: the team that builds the real, working enterprise software behind pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality, and supply chain operations, and extends that same foundation to adjacent regulated and process industries.
about.p2: Our own proprietary technology is configured into real, working industry solutions — pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality and document management, laboratory information management, equipment and asset management, animal feed and premix manufacturing, livestock and aquaculture farm management, cosmetics and medical device manufacturing, pharmacy retail, cold-chain 3PL warehousing, and consumer product distribution, among others.
about.p3: We build around three values: People, Partnerships, and Progress — for a healthier world. Every industry solution presented on our Solutions page is backed by a real, seeded dataset and verified end-to-end workflows, not mockups or placeholder screenshots.
about.p4: In the interest of transparency: this technology showcase runs on realistic seed data created for demonstration purposes, not live customer transactions — company names, quantities, and figures shown throughout are illustrative. What is real is the software itself: every workflow, screen, and integration here is functioning, working code, built on the same technology foundation we use for real deployments.

vendorProfile.companyText: PharmaCountry Enterprise Solutions is based in Vietnam, building and supporting enterprise software for pharmaceutical, healthcare, and adjacent regulated and process industries.
vendorProfile.techText: This platform runs on a modern, enterprise-grade technology foundation, with customer-facing web applications — including this site — built using current web application standards. Business data is stored in a real, production-grade relational database, and the entire stack is deployed using containerized infrastructure, the same architecture behind every industry solution shown on this site.
vendorProfile.deploymentIntro: For a real customer engagement, PharmaCountry Enterprise Solutions supports three deployment models — standard for modern enterprise software:
vendorProfile.deploymentDedicatedText: A private instance on infrastructure of your choice.
vendorProfile.deploymentOnPremText: Deployed inside your own data center.
vendorProfile.deploymentNote: This showcase itself runs as one specific cloud deployment — the deployment model for a real customer is a choice made together with you.
vendorProfile.methodologyIntro: A real implementation typically follows a standard, proven sequence. Exact scope and timeline are agreed with each customer based on their industry and complexity — nothing here is a fixed timeline or quote.

vendorProfile.supportText: Support is part of every engagement, from initial configuration through day-to-day operation after go-live. As with scope and timeline, the specifics of a support plan are agreed per engagement rather than fixed in advance.
vendorProfile.securityText: Security and per-account data isolation are core to how this platform is built, not an afterthought. Every industry solution runs on our own role-based permission system, and per-account data isolation has been built and empirically verified across multiple live portals on this platform: the Dealer, Supplier, and Farm portals each restrict a logged-in user to their own data using the platform's own permission-scoping mechanism — verified by confirming that two different portal logins genuinely see non-overlapping records, not just a status flag claiming so. In a real multi-tenant deployment, each customer's data is further isolated at the instance level.
